verdicts.reason: A breaks the hierarchy: the headline is blown up to a two-line block running into the pills, the CTA pill is oversized and dominates, the subhead is shrunk and pushed into the top-right corner, and the flavour pills come out tiny, in reverse order and crammed against the right edge. B keeps the original's clean left-to-right banner structure: headline, subhead and pills are aligned on the left with the CTA balanced on the right. Its only flaws are minor: the decorative circles are enlarged and now take up more of the canvas, and the pill text is small.
